'''''Bio-Engineer Poster''''' was a poster available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which took place during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The foreground depicted a genetically enhanced [[nudfuh]]&mdash;a [[Species/Legends|species]] native to [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]&mdash;with a [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] strand in the background and a spinal [[Bone/Legends|bone]] to the left. It was [[Color/Legends|colored]] in various shades of yellow and orange. Lettering at the bottom, in the [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] alphabet known as [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]], spelled out the word "Bio-Engineer".<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Bio-Engineer Poster'' was a poster available to players of the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']],<ref name="SWG" /> which was released on [[June 26]], [[2003]]<ref name="Start">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/videogames/news/news20030617.html|text=''Galaxies'' to Release June 26}}</ref> and shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> It could be obtained by looting a picture printer and various other items from enemies within the game. Once collected, the player could combine the items and get a random painting or poster. The other artwork the player could receive were ''[[Droid in Contrast]]'' and ''[[Double Helix]]''. Following the release of the ''New Game Enhancements'' game update in [[November]] [[2005]], the poster became random loot the player could receive after killing a humanoid enemy. The player could use the poster as decoration for his or her in-game home.<ref name="SWG" />
